constructionTiers.name: Basic / Essential Standard
constructionTiers.tagline: Cost-effective, structurally sound construction using dependable standard materials.
constructionTiers.idealFor: Budget homes, rental floors, farm storeys & cost-optimized residential builds.

specifications.structure: Standard RCC frame (M20 grade), standard country bricks or solid concrete blocks
specifications.flooring: Vitrified tiles up to ₹50/sq.ft (600x600mm) or ceramic flooring
specifications.doorsWindows: Sal wood frame with flush doors, standard powder-coated aluminum sliding windows
specifications.electrical: Concealed ISI copper wiring (Anchor / Polycab) with standard modular switches
specifications.plumbingSanitary: CPVC / PVC pipelines with Parryware / Cera basic white sanitary fittings
specifications.painting: Tractor emulsion interior (2 coats over putty), Ace exterior weather-proof finish
specifications.kitchen: Polished granite counter (18mm) with stainless steel sink & ceramic tiles up to 2 ft

specifications.doorsWindows: Teak wood main door frame with veneered shutter, UPVC casement windows with mesh
specifications.electrical: Fire-retardant Havells / Finolex wiring, Legrand / Schneider modular switches

specifications.painting: Asian Paints Apcolite / Royale Luxury emulsion, Apex Ultima exterior anti-algal finish
specifications.kitchen: Black galaxy granite slab, Carysil quartz / Franke sink, 4ft designer wall dado

specifications.doorsWindows: Complete seasoned teak wood frames & designer doors, Fenesta / Schuco acoustic UPVC systems

Red clay brick / solid concrete masonry walls with 1:6 cement mortar

Standard vitrified flooring (600x600mm) up to ₹50/sq.ft allowance
Concealed Anchor / Finolex electrical conduits with standard switches
Parryware white sanitary fixtures and basic brass chrome taps
Tractor emulsion interior paint (2 coats over 1 coat primer)
12 months post-handover seepage and leakage repair guarantee

Temporary construction electrical meter and permanent EB transformer charges
Borewell drilling, submersible pump and underground sump beyond 6,000L
Compound wall beyond front gate and decorative landscaping
Interior false ceiling and modular wardrobe cabinetry
